## What changes and why?

Link the issue and explain the resulting behavior. Keep the title and summary spoiler-free.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and their results. State any limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the applicable terms in LICENSE.
- [ ] I preserved attribution and identified third-party sources and material AI assistance.
- [ ] I kept private records, credentials, and unpublished weekly attempts out of this change.
- [ ] Any GM material is clearly labeled and intentionally separated from player-facing content.
- [ ] This change does not silently alter a released challenge's fixed acceptance constraints.
- [ ] A challenge draft is not being presented as an official release without maintainer review.
